title: Production comedy script
script: Ladies and gentlemen, OpenClaw. Your assistant, on your devices, in your chats. After TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin, Gradle, Docker, and a security audit you did not request. Three hundred and eighty-seven thousand stars. Thirty public contributors. Huge crowd. Tiny kitchen staff. Renamed Warelay, Clawdbot, Moltbot, OpenClaw. Branding of a company changing its name during a CAPTCHA. Users find the setup intimidating. The landing page is still taking a bow.
